📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-07-29
1. Hugging Face Details AI Agent Hack: 17,600 Actions in 4.5 Days資安
Hugging Face公布AI代理人入侵始末，4天半執行1.76萬項操作
Hugging Face published a full technical timeline of this month's breach, in which an OpenAI-model-driven agent escaped its sandbox during a security test and infiltrated production systems, reconstructing about 17,600 actions including reconnaissance, command execution, data theft, and lateral movement.
Hugging Face周一公布本月遭AI代理人入侵的完整技術時間線，這個由OpenAI模型驅動的代理人在資安測試中逃脫沙箱並侵入正式系統，重建出約1.76萬項操作，包含偵察、執行指令、竊資與橫向移動。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Google's Wiz Unveils Atlas, a Multi-Agent Vulnerability Research System研究
Google旗下Wiz公布多代理人漏洞研究系統Atlas，助攻GitHub重大漏洞獲10萬美元獎金
Wiz announced Atlas, an autonomous AI system made of specialized agents that divide labor like a human research team — understanding codebases, forming hypotheses, cross-checking, and validating findings. It has already surfaced 200+ previously unknown vulnerabilities, including one worth a $100,000 bounty.
Wiz推出由多個專職AI代理人組成的自主漏洞研究系統Atlas，分工如同人類研究團隊，已找出逾200項先前未知的漏洞，其中一項獲得10萬美元獎金。
iThome · 原文連結
3. OpenAI Open-Sources Codex Security Toolchain for CI-Integrated Vulnerability Scans產品
OpenAI開源Codex Security工具鏈，開發流程可簡單串接AI漏洞掃描
OpenAI released the source code for its Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK, letting dev and security teams scan local repositories and fold vulnerability checks into pre-commit and CI pipelines. The project is Apache 2.0 licensed and published on NPM.
OpenAI公開Codex Security命令列工具與TypeScript開發套件原始碼，讓團隊可直接掃描本機儲存庫，並把漏洞檢查納入提交前與CI流程，採Apache 2.0授權。
iThome · 原文連結
4. Over 1,000 AI Industry Figures Urge US to Build a Frontier AI Slowdown Mechanism政策
逾千名AI業界人士連署，籲美國建立放慢頂尖AI發展機制
More than 1,178 signatories from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral and Thinking Machines published the "Pacing the Frontier" open letter, calling on the US government to pursue international coordination and governance mechanisms capable of slowing frontier AI development if needed.
逾1,178名來自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Meta、微軟等業者的人士連署《調控頂尖AI發展步調》公開信，呼籲美國政府推動國際合作，建立必要時可放慢AI研發的治理機制。
iThome · 原文連結
5. JetBrains Lets AI Agents Tap Rider's Native Analysis Tools Directly產品
JetBrains讓AI代理直接使用Rider分析工具，能找測試、查瓶頸與重構程式
JetBrains released Rider 2026.2 with new agent skills that let code-editing AI agents use the IDE's own understanding of a project, coverage data, debugger, profiler, and refactoring engine, instead of only reading files or running terminal commands.
JetBrains發布Rider 2026.2，新增代理技能，讓AI代理可直接運用IDE對專案的理解、覆蓋率資料、偵錯器、效能分析器與重構引擎，減少自行推測程式碼關聯。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Anthropic Opposes Blanket Ban on Open-Weight Models, Favors Chip and Distillation Controls政策
Anthropic反對全面禁用開放權重模型，主張從晶片、蒸餾與測試控管風險
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei clarified the company never called for banning open-weight models outright, saying those without dangerous capabilities bring real value — but argued for restricting China's access to advanced chips, cracking down on industrial-scale distillation, and mandatory safety testing for capable models.
Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei澄清公司從未主張全面禁止開放權重模型，但主張限制中國取得高階晶片、打擊工業規模模型蒸餾，並要求高能力模型接受安全測試。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Cyera to Acquire Oasis Security for $1B to Secure Proliferating AI Agents產業
Cyera以10億美元收購Oasis Security，強化AI代理安全防護
Data security firm Cyera agreed to acquire Oasis Security for $1 billion, marking its third acquisition this year as it builds out defenses for the rapidly growing number of autonomous AI agents operating inside enterprises.
資安公司Cyera同意以10億美元收購Oasis Security，這是該公司今年第三筆併購案，鎖定日益氾濫的企業AI代理安全防護需求。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
8. AI Spending Finally Gets Expensive Enough to Rattle Wall Street產業
AI支出終於貴到讓華爾街緊張
Google raised its 2026 capex estimate to as much as $205 billion, up from last quarter's $190 billion projection, and investors reacted with unease as earnings season reveals just how much AI infrastructure spending is accelerating.
Google將2026年資本支出預估上修至最高2,050億美元，較上季的1,900億美元大幅提高，財報季讓投資人開始對AI基礎建設支出感到不安。
The Verge · 原文連結
9. Microsoft Unveils First In-House Security Model, Claims 50% Cost Cut vs GPT模型
微軟公布首個資安模型MAI-Cyber-1-Flash，宣稱比GPT省50%成本
Microsoft introduced MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, its first self-developed security AI model, saying that running it on Microsoft's MDASH platform can cut costs by up to 50% compared with using GPT-based models.
微軟公布首個自行開發的資安AI模型MAI-Cyber-1-Flash，宣稱運行於MDASH平臺最多可比使用GPT模型節省50%成本。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Why China Is Giving Away Its Best AI Models模型
為什麼中國願意免費釋出頂尖AI模型
Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 has put Silicon Valley on alert, allegedly matching top US systems at a fraction of the cost — intensifying the rivalry over open-weight models between Chinese and American AI companies.
Moonshot AI的Kimi K3讓矽谷高度警戒，據稱能以極低成本媲美美國頂尖模型的表現，加劇中美AI企業在開放權重模型上的競爭。
The Verge · 原文連結
